description: The MCP server's prompts: a client fills the arguments (strings) and gets a user message that says how to use the tools for that job.

prompts.name: answer_with_sources
prompts.title: Answer with Everloot's sources
prompts.description: Answer a question about WoW: Forever from answer_sources, citing each piece of evidence with its source, licence and date, and saying unrecorded where the evidence is.

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: The question, in the player's words.

prompts.name: review_talent_plan
prompts.title: Review a talent share code
prompts.description: Read a share code with talent_plan and the class's trees with talent_tree, then describe the build, its level and every problem in plain words.

arguments.name: code
arguments.description: An EL1 share code, or a calculator link that carries one.

prompts.name: what_changed
prompts.title: What changed in WoW: Forever
prompts.description: Summarize recent_changes, newest first: Blizzard posts, hotfixes and builds, each with its link, quoting only the excerpt the tool gives.

arguments.name: game
arguments.description: forever or classic. Without it, both.
